high_level_description: The image depicts two individuals standing on a red carpet at what appears to be the premiere of "Spider-Man: No Way Home," as indicated by the backdrop. The backdrop features the Marvel Studios logo and the title "Spider-Man: No Way Home" prominently displayed in bold, colorful letters. The person on the left is dressed in a formal black suit with a white shirt and no tie. They have dark, curly hair and are smiling warmly at the other individual. The person on the right is wearing an elegant, sheer dress with a spiderweb pattern and a high slit on one side.
